learning_outcomes.text: The student can independently search and understand documentation (schematics, datasheets, programming manuals, ...).
The student can independently perform and analyze measurements.
The student can implement and debug a protocol in software from the available documentation.
The student is able to find errors in a communication protocol (software and hardware errors).

syllabus_topics: Implement UART communication protocol in software
Implement I 2C communication protocol in software
Implement SPI communication protocol in software
Implement Modbus via RS485 communication protocol in software with hardware support
Implement I2S communication protocol in software with hardware support
Capture and analyze USB data streams with Wireshark
Capture and analyze TCP/IP data streams with Wireshark
assessment_rules: The total grade is on a scale of 1-20, based on a 100% practical, closed-book exam. The exam consists of an assignment to ensure two entities communicate correctly via a communication link, which may involve writing code and/or debugging an existing system on a lab PC using microcontrollers. The ability to work with measuring equipment (logic analyzer, oscilloscope, ...) is also an important part of the evaluation. Resit arrangements follow the same modalities as the first examination opportunity; there are no partial transfers for this course.
